description: This file defines exception handlers for FastAPI, including HTTP exceptions, request validation errors, and WebSocket validation errors. It imports relevant modules and provides asynchronous functions to handle different exception scenarios, returning appropriate responses or closing WebSocket connections.

methods.name: Response http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: HTTPException)
methods.description: Handles general HTTP exceptions by returning a Response object with the appropriate status code and headers, or a JSONResponse with the exception detail.

methods.name: JSONResponse request_validation_exception_handler( request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError )
methods.description: Handles request validation errors during API requests by returning a JSONResponse containing the encoded error details with status 422.

methods.name: None websocket_request_validation_exception_handler( websocket: WebSocket, exc: WebSocketRequestValidationError )
methods.description: Handles WebSocket request validation errors by closing the WebSocket connection with a policy violation code and reason containing the encoded error details.

ctags.name: http_exception_handler
ctags.pattern: /^async def http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: HTTPException) -> Response:$/
